draft.subject: Photographing Midnight Quartet at Weill Recital Hall.
draft.body: I photograph performing arts in New York and saw Midnight Quartet is self-presenting at Weill Recital Hall on August 15. I have worked Carnegie Hall for nearly ten years, and shoot unobtrusive, no-flash documentary coverage that a chamber audience does not notice. My portfolio is at danwrightphotography.com. I would be glad to hear what you have planned for photography that night. I look forward to hearing from you.
